acceptanceCriteria.founderCheck: Try to make this happen on purpose: send more than one reminder per day. It should not be possible.
acceptanceCriteria.howToCheck: Deliberately attempt it — as a user and through any background process or connected service. Expected: it is blocked, nothing is changed or shared, and the attempt is recorded as evidence.
acceptanceCriteria.statement: When any user or process attempts to send more than one reminder per day, the system shall prevent it.

acceptanceCriteria.founderCheck: Check for yourself: I use it for two weeks and throw away less food than before.
acceptanceCriteria.howToCheck: Record the observed result against this statement: what was measured, by whom, and when.
acceptanceCriteria.statement: When the first version is evaluated, the product owner shall be able to observe that: I use it for two weeks and throw away less food than before.

coreWorkflow.text: Add an item and its expiry date in under 10 seconds
See everything sorted by what expires first
Get a reminder the day before an item expires
Mark an item as used or thrown away

intent.desiredOutcome: They throw away less food because they get a nudge the day before something expires
intent.jobToBeDone: Keep track of what is in the fridge and use food before it expires, without writing lists

mustNot.text: Send more than one reminder per day

outOfScope.text: Sharing a fridge with other people

successCriteria.text: I use it for two weeks and throw away less food than before

intent.targetUser: Busy home cooks who do one big weekly shop
